sectors.name: Logistics
themes: Indonesia's captive-port and toll-road logistics operators are re-rating on structural cargo diversion away from congested Jakarta gateways, a durable multi-year volume shift.

sectors.ai: Logistics is a two-sided tape: Indonesian names (SAFE, PPGL, MITI) are surging on domestic volume normalization and port/captive demand, while US freight (CHRW, SAIA, UPS) shows only selective strength. Buy the ID laggards with hard-asset exposure (CMNP) and avoid US pure-play LTL until rate inflection; trim any aggregate beta.
